pinned_harbor_dockerfile:
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 python:3.14-slim
RUN sed -i 's|http://deb.debian.org|https://deb.debian.org|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    bash git curl ca-certificates g++ openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev libhdf5-dev hdf5-tools libglu1-mesa libgl1 util-linux \
    libxrender1 libxcursor1 libxfixes3 libxft2 libfontconfig1 libxinerama1 libgomp1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd --uid 1000 --create-home solver
WORKDIR /app
COPY agent.zip /tmp/agent.zip
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.txt
RUN python -m zipfile -e /tmp/agent.zip /app \
    && python -m pip install --no-cache-dir /app -r /tmp/requirements.txt \
    && mkdir -p /app/submission

findings.finding: All 43 non-CFDCodeBench chapter-two statements promise SciPy. RC5 source already has per-task environment requirements (71 files across the 82 tasks; 69 contain SciPy), including scipy==1.18.1 for 2.1.1/2.1.3. All 71 requirements files are absent from qbank.zip, so extracted release workspaces lose the intended environment supplement. The SDK lock alone intentionally does not include solver-only SciPy; it cannot replace these omitted execution requirements.

release.py extract returns no task harbor/requirements.txt because the archive omitted them. prepare_harbor then writes an empty fallback requirements file when these extracted tasks are used. The source distribution contains the original requirements but the data release consumer does not automatically recover them. Fix the release allowlist, checksums and installation/bootstrap consumption chain; preserve mature per-task requirements rather than papering over the omission.

All public SDK README files require Gmsh system dynamic libraries, which pip cannot install. The Docker build currently has libglu1-mesa/libgl1 and related libraries, but clean-platform validation must exercise Gmsh initialization rather than rely only on Python package resolution.
Promised C++/OpenMP/OpenMPI/HDF5 capabilities require working compiler/link/runtime probes. Import-only checks do not prove the native promises. GPU and per-task limits remain separately controlled.

Agent-side package installations are mutable and do not demonstrate availability in a fresh independent verifier. Validation must start both phases independently from the released baseline image, with the verifier offline and no agent writable environment reused.

recommended_acceptance: Reuse existing per-task harbor/requirements.txt from the pinned source, include it in release artifact/checksum/extraction, and make both Harbor and supported release bootstrap consume it. Shared baseline environment declarations may be centralized; do not duplicate SciPy policy per task or put it into CONTRACT/SDK merely to mask a packaging omission.

Use the released public package and fixed task mapping to build a task environment. Provision all promised Python components plus system capabilities before the model sees the task; record exact image and package identities.

For each of all 82 tasks, start a fresh candidate container and a separate fresh verifier container. Verify declared Python imports, SciPy sparse capability where promised, Gmsh initialize/finalize, runtime/tool provider identity, g++ compilation, OpenMP compilation/runtime, MPI compiler/runtime and HDF5 compile/link/read capability where promised.
Network-disabled verifier probes must succeed without carrying over candidate install side effects. Confirm hidden/reference assets are inaccessible to the solver user.

Ship supported Docker/build/bootstrap and preflight instructions with RC6; state whether image build requires network. Dataset offline completeness is separate from bundled images/wheels/system dependencies.

Record unchanged hashes for all task instructions/DATA, formal inputs, reference assets, grading configurations, sample roles, case identities and numerical scoring. If public packaging or environment installation docs change, list those changes explicitly.
Release erratum and runtime qualification do not correct model scores or certify scientific reference accuracy. Preserve RC5 attachments and report the user-requested exclusion of score correction.
root_cause: Release packaging/consumption omitted existing per-task environment requirements. Source environment configuration and SDK-only dependency lock are distinct responsibilities.
